I can't give you an amount for caffeine, that's one for a doctor or dietitian since the right number depends on your body, your health and any medication you take.

In general terms, caffeine affects people very differently. Timing matters too, because coffee late in the day can cost you sleep, and sleep does more for your training than any pre-workout trick. If you're jittery, your heart is racing, or your stomach is unsettled in the gym, that tells you it's too much for you.

A doctor or dietitian can give you a number that fits you. I'm happy to help with the training side in the meantime.
